caption:
Bad visa advice: "your credit card insurance is enough."

Usually it is not. Schengen medical cover has specific conditions: a minimum coverage amount, validity across all Schengen states, cover for the entire stay, and repatriation.

Fail one and it is a technical rejection — decided before anyone reads your cover letter.

slides.note: Travel insurance and Schengen-compliant medical insurance are not the same product.

slides.headline: CONDITIONS IT MUST MEET
items: Cover for the entire duration of the stay
slides.footnote: Fail one condition and the policy does not qualify.

slides.body: Your file is never assessed on its merits. It fails on a document that was easy to get right.
slides.note: The most avoidable outcome in the entire process.

slides.headline: THE CHEAPEST REFUSAL TO PREVENT.
slides.sub: And the one we see most often.

slides.headline: YOU RELY ON A POLICY
items: Read the coverage amount, not the marketing
Confirm it names the Schengen area, not just 'worldwide'
Check it covers your full stay, not a shorter window
